tool.name: Noodle Biomedical Literature Discovery
tool.description: search public biomedical papers through the Noodle MCP

param.name: query
param.label: Biomedical question or identifier
param.help: Natural language, PMID, DOI, PMCID, gene, variant, phenotype, HPO, or OMIM query.

tool.help:
Searches the public PubMed-derived Noodle corpus. Exact identifiers can anchor semantic discovery. Citation or semantic proximity is a discovery signal, not causality, diagnosis, or treatment advice. Do not submit patient or private data.
Documentation: https://noodle.helena.bio/mcp
